resources.string: Sharper colored text
Full color detail (4:4:4), so colored text and thin lines stay crisp. Turn it on if they look blurry; it takes more decoding power and needs PC and device support.
Controllers
A player each makes every controller its own player and suits almost everyone. One player makes every controller player 1; Off sends no controller to the PC.
How the PC places the stream’s virtual display beside its monitors. The Exclusive choice switches the PC’s monitors off during the stream; they come back when it ends. Needs PC support.
Finds and saves the fastest pace at which a PC’s PyroWave frames arrive whole, for links that lose frame ends, such as a USB Ethernet dock. Takes one to three minutes.
Measures ping, jitter and loss, and download speed where the PC supports it.

A touch gamepad drawn over the stream, for playing without a physical controller. It covers part of the picture; lower Opacity to see more of the game.
How fast a physical mouse moves the PC’s pointer. The touch modes have their own speed settings.
Pointer speed in the Trackpad touch mode.
Pointer speed in the Local cursor touch mode. At the default the pointer moves as far as your finger.
How much farther fast swipes go.
How far the pointer glides.
How much of the screen height the on-screen PC keyboard takes. Larger gives bigger keys; smaller leaves more of the stream visible.
How see-through the on-screen PC keyboard is. A lower value shows more of the stream behind it.
Vibrates when you press on-screen controls (not the Classic controller’s buttons) if the system’s touch feedback is on, and for a game’s rumble when no physical controller takes it.
Adds a Guide button (Home or PS) to the on-screen controls.
Keeps sound on the PC’s speakers while streaming.
The corner the performance overlay sits in.
Puts every setting back to its default; PCs, games, profiles and language stay.
